Issue 21:
# 21 — useAdminMutation hook

Status: needs-triage
Type: AFK

## What to build

`AdminProducts` and `AdminOrderDetail` each invent their own loading/error/optimistic-rollback pattern inline. Every new admin mutation would repeat this. Extract a `useAdminMutation` hook that owns this state machine so page components only call `mutate(fn)` and read `{ loading, error }`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `src/hooks/useAdminMutation.js` exports `useAdminMutation()` returning `{ mutate, loading, error, clearError }`
- [ ] `mutate(asyncFn)` sets `loading: true`, awaits the function, sets `loading: false` on completion; on throw/rejection sets `error` to the caught message
- [ ] `AdminProducts.jsx` uses `useAdminMutation` for `toggleAvailability` and `deleteProduct` — inline loading/error state removed from both
- [ ] `AdminOrderDetail.jsx` uses `useAdminMutation` for status transition actions — inline loading/error state removed
- [ ] Unit tests cover: loading state during async call, error state on rejection, clearError resets error, successful call clears error
- [ ] No existing tests broken

## Blocked by

None — can start immediately.

plan.sprint_goal: Extract a reusable useAdminMutation hook to eliminate duplicated loading/error state logic in AdminProducts and AdminOrderDetail, and ship unit tests covering the hook's state machine

dev1.task: Create src/hooks/useAdminMutation.js exporting useAdminMutation() that returns { mutate, loading, error, clearError }. mutate(asyncFn) must: set loading true before awaiting asyncFn, set loading false after completion, set error to caught message string on rejection, and clear any previous error on a successful call. Then refactor AdminProducts.jsx to use useAdminMutation for toggleAvailability and deleteProduct (remove all inline loading/error state for those two actions), and refactor AdminOrderDetail.jsx to use useAdminMutation for the status transition actions (Confirm Order, Mark as Sent), removing their inline loading/error state.
dev1.context_needed: Read src/pages/admin/AdminProducts.jsx to understand existing toggleAvailability and deleteProduct inline loading/error patterns. Read src/pages/admin/AdminOrderDetail.jsx to understand existing status transition inline loading/error patterns. The hook must use plain React useState — no external libraries. error should store a string (the caught Error's message or String(e)), not the raw Error object, so it can be rendered directly in JSX.

dev2.task: Write unit tests for useAdminMutation in src/hooks/useAdminMutation.test.js using Vitest + @testing-library/react (renderHook + act). Tests must cover: (1) loading is true during the async call and false after it resolves, (2) error is set to the caught message string when asyncFn rejects, (3) clearError resets error to null, (4) a successful mutate call clears a previously set error, (5) loading returns to false even when asyncFn throws. Ensure no existing tests in the repo are broken after the hook refactor — run the full test suite and fix any snapshot or import breakage caused by the AdminProducts/AdminOrderDetail changes.
dev2.context_needed: Read src/hooks/useAdminMutation.js (created by Dev1 — coordinate on the exact export signature before writing tests). Review src/test/setup.js for global test configuration and any existing mocks. Check src/components/AdminRoute.test.jsx and src/context/CartContext.test.jsx for established renderHook/act patterns used in this repo to stay consistent.

plan.shared_types: Hook return shape: { mutate: (asyncFn: () => Promise<void>) => Promise<void>, loading: boolean, error: string | null, clearError: () => void }. error is always a string or null — never an Error object. mutate itself should not rethrow so callers do not need try/catch.
